Cartograph-Generation.description: Index generation the answer was read from

ETag.description: For If-None-Match, or If-Match on PUT …/config

ActivityItem.description:
One row of the activity list (FE-16), kept in the workspace's ask.db. `text` and `detail` hold
repo and author names, which are untrusted: the app renders them as text. Never file contents.

detail.description: Who ran it and which version: "Indexed by the background sync · cartograph 0.4.0".

href.description: The app view the row opens, as a path and hash.

text.description:
"billing-service synced to 3e0d7a2 · 3 commits by Tom Ellery and Jon Reyes", at most 120
characters.

ids.description: Marks these read; empty marks everything read.

ApiError.description: E1 on the wire: what, why and what to try.

date.description: Corrected time on the merged timeline.

affected.description: Node ids that depend, directly or not, on what the commit touched.

Confidence.description: The server sends `level`; clients never derive it from `score` (ruling R20).

oneOf.description: 0.90 to 1.00: both ends anchored.
0.30 to 0.59. Under 0.30 is stored but hidden by default.

undocumented.description: The service's undocumented routes, on its first spec.

ContractCounts.description: The four counts of the Contracts view.

stale.description: The correction no longer matches any link.

manifest.description: Also write `cartograph.yaml` in the workspace folder (C7); never overwrites one.

by_repo.description: Commits per repo, in the order of `TimelineDensity.repos`; empty in a node's series.

DiscoveredFolder.description: One row of the C1 and C2 resolution table.

estimate_s.description: From a measured rate, not a guess.

ErrorBody.description: Every error response, whatever the status code.

oneOf.description: 400: a malformed parameter or body.
401: the bearer token is missing or wrong.
403: the Origin header doesn't match, or `Sec-Fetch-Site` is `cross-site`.
403: the Host header isn't on the allow list (DNS rebinding).
405: OPTIONS, or a method the route doesn't take. There is no CORS.
400: a node reference matches more than one node; `details.candidates` lists them.
409: a job of that kind is already running.
412: `If-Match` failed; the file changed on disk.
413: a body over the limit.
415: a write without `Content-Type: application/json`.
422: valid JSON, invalid request (a correction key that matches nothing).
422: the answer is over the response cap; `try` names a narrower scope.
429: too many concurrent requests or Ask runs.
503: the index needs a migration or a rebuild.
503: the query ran past its deadline.
500. The body never carries SQL, a path outside the workspace or a stack trace.

EvidenceGroups.description: Evidence by role. Contract rows wait for contracts (XS-08).

EvidenceSite.description: One place in a file that backs a link. `snippet` is repo text: show it as text, never markup.

snippet.description: At most 5 lines and 400 characters, secrets masked; null when the repo can't be read.

ExtractorInfo.description: An extractor the index holds facts from (IDX-21), with the live files it read.

version.description: The newest version that wrote facts.

FileDiff.description: What a write to a committed file did, or would do.

Freshness.description: What every read says about how current the index is (D1).

FsEntry.description:
`GET /api/v1/fs/list`: names and three flags only (ruling R25). The list reads only the folder
asked for, never inside a child, so listing home can't raise macOS privacy prompts for Desktop,
Documents or Downloads; the flags are null (unknown) and a folder is read when it is opened.

GraphSlice.description:
`GET …/graph`: one level's nodes and links, columnar so 60k nodes and 200k links stay small.
Column `i` of every node array describes node `i`; links index into the node columns.

range.description: Set for `range=` requests: links live at any step in `[from, to)`.

ImpactRequest.description: `POST …/impact` carries exactly one of these; it changes nothing.

ImpactResult.description:
What depends on the changed nodes, directly or not. A node's level is the weakest link on its
strongest path from a changed node.

changed.description: The nodes the input named or changed.

services.description: The services the affected nodes belong to.

truncated.description: A resource cap (50k visited nodes, depth 12, 5 s) stopped the walk.

IndexRun.description:
One index run (IDX-22): when it ran, the binary that wrote it, and its coverage totals. The
totals are absent on a run that stopped before its end.

Interval.description: `[from_seq, to_seq)` on the merged first-parent timeline.

JobKind.description: A fixed enum: nothing else can be started over HTTP.

KeyWrite.description: The only request body with a key.

Lineage.description: One row of `…/nodes/{id}/history` (board G10): a path the node had, and how it got it.

to.description: Null while the node still has this path.

oneOf.description: The path first appeared, or a structure node's span began.
Moved with the same blob.
Moved with similar content; `similarity` says how similar.

Link.description: `lib/workspace.ts` Link: `type` becomes `kind`, and commits are given with their timeline step.

LinkChange.description: One row of `…/nodes/{id}/changes`: a commit that added or removed a link touching the scope.

corrected.description: A correction decides this link (FE-14/XS-12); false until those exist.

weight.description: How many file-level links this aggregated link stands for.

evidence.description: The code behind the link, by its role in it.

layer.description: The layer whose answer the map shows. Null until precedence layers exist (XS-08 onwards).

opened.description: The commit that opened the link, and the one that closed it (null while live).

operation.description: HTTP links: the call's method and route template.

replaced.description: A link between the same two services that closed in the commit this one opened.

LinkKey.description: A link named by people-readable parts (ruling R28: the nested key object).

LinkKind.description: Link kinds on every wire (ruling R28).

Lod.description: Level of detail of a graph slice.

ask.description: One of the five Ask registers.

churn.description: Links added or removed in the 90 days before `at`.

service.description: Owning service; null for the workspace root.

children.description: Number of children one level down, for the expand affordance.

parent.description: Index of the parent node in these columns, or -1.

NodeId.description: A node: workspace, service, module, file, operation, channel, table, entrypoint, symbol.

Operation.description: An operation of a spec. `id` is `o<row>`, not a node.

path.description: With the spec's base path, as the spec writes it: `/v1/orders/{id}`.

summary.description: From the spec: untrusted text (F8), at most 200 characters.

OperationStatus.description: Whether the code agrees with the spec about an operation (XS-08 drift).

oneOf.description: A parsed route serves it.
The spec lists it and no route serves it.
Each hop goes from a node to what it depends on.
Each hop goes from a node to what depends on it.
Hops in both directions.

level.description: A path's level is its weakest hop.

Prefs.description: Preferences moved to the server by ruling R1.

local_only.description: Pending ruling N2: refuse every non-loopback provider.

Problem.description: A what, why and try triple inside a payload (not an HTTP error).

Provider.description: A key is write-only: the browser learns `key_saved` and nothing else (G4).

ProviderWrite.description: The only request bodies with a `base_url`.

RankedNode.description:
One row of `…/nodes/{id}/ranking`: a file in the scope and how much depends on it (blast
radius), as `lib/workspace.ts` `ranking` computes it.

used_by.description: Live links into the file at `at`.

uses.description: Live links out of it at `at`.

truncated.description: A resource cap stopped the walk.

behind_capped.description: True when `behind` hit the cap; show it as "1000+".

dirty.description: Computed after the answer and cached; null on a first read (D1).

RepoId.description: A repository in a workspace: its canonical path's registry key.

oneOf.description: The engine's answer, before any model text.
Raw model text not yet split into a checked sentence.
After a repair, the whole answer is replaced.
The answer came from the graph engine alone (G5).

SearchResults.description:
`GET …/search`: the hits best first (bm25, then fan-in, then shorter paths), and when nothing
matched, the nearest name (board G05's "did you mean").

ServerEvent.description:
`GET /api/v1/events`: one stream for every workspace (ruling R15). The current state is sent on
connect.

oneOf.description: At most 4 a second.
Rows marked read in one tab, so every other tab clears them too. Empty: every row.

detect_source.description:
The file that rule read, repository-relative: `cartograph.yaml`, a catalog or workspace file,
or a package's own manifest; none for `repo` (board S04's "Detected from").

detected_by.description:
The C6 rule that found it: `manifest`, `scope`, `backstage`, `pnpm`, `npm-workspaces`,
`go.work`, `nx`, `cargo`, `composer` or `repo` (board S04).

library.description: A workspace package with no deployable marker (C6).

repos.description: The repos `by_repo` counts, in that order (board G04 stacks by repo).

UndocumentedRoute.description: A route of a service that has a spec, which no spec lists.

Unresolved.description:
A reference that didn't resolve (IDX-22). `text` is the raw specifier: untrusted text (F8),
shown as text only.

path.description: The file's path now, repo-prefixed as node paths are.

info.description: Served by `cartograph open` on 127.0.0.1 only. Every /api/* request sends Authorization: Bearer <token>. Writes also need a matching Origin and Content-Type: application/json. snake_case on the wire. Generated by `cargo run -p cartograph-api --bin gen-contract`; do not edit.
